affected_kernel: Qwen3 QK-norm JIT in piecewise CUDA graph
evidence_snippet: Server crashes during CUDA graph warmup with torch._dynamo.exc.Unsupported.
rationale: Dynamo traced logging and JIT/filesystem operations inside the QK-norm capability check.
counterfactual_rationale: A Qwen3 server warmup with piecewise CUDA graphs and inductor is needed.

evidence_snippet: Qwen3.5 FP8 accuracy drops about 12pp on Blackwell when DeepGemm is active.
rationale: E8M0 scale precision loss compounds across many FP8 block-quantized layers.
counterfactual_rationale: The Blackwell GSM8K accuracy CI/model matrix would expose it.

evidence_snippet: Review summary says the RoPE definition was missing or incorrect for AMD GPUs.
rationale: The fix adds the missing ROCm rotary_embedding definition/import path.
counterfactual_rationale: An AMD/ROCm build-import test for RoPE would catch it.

evidence_snippet: Use impl_abstract if register_fake does not exist.
rationale: The custom-op registration path was incompatible with older PyTorch APIs.
counterfactual_rationale: A dependency-version CI job with older PyTorch would fail.

introducing_evidence: This PR fixes an issue created by #28406
evidence_snippet: Shared experts must get original hidden_states, not the combined one due to DP+EP execution.
rationale: A MoE integration path reused mutated hidden states and corrupted outputs.
counterfactual_rationale: The failing config combines FlashInfer MLA, FP8/FP4 MoE, DP, EP, and DeepSeek.

evidence_snippet: HiSparse+compressor_v2 GSM8K accuracy improved from 0.825 to 0.960 after the fix.
rationale: The PR reports a large accuracy recovery in the HiSparse compressor path.
counterfactual_rationale: A realistic DeepSeek/GSM8K workload exposes the accuracy loss.

affected_kernel: FlashInfer TRT-LLM FP4 MoE online scale under CUDA graph
evidence_snippet: A plain float scale causes a pageable host-to-device copy, illegal during CUDA graph capture.
rationale: The fix creates the scale on device so graph capture does not perform an illegal host copy.
counterfactual_rationale: A CUDA-graph warmup using the NVFP4 FlashInfer TRT-LLM path would fail.

affected_kernel: AITER RMSNorm for Qwen3 Q/K norm
evidence_snippet: Passing strided 3D Q/K views directly to Aiter can memory-fault on MI325/gfx942.
rationale: The fix makes unsafe strided/higher-rank RMSNorm inputs contiguous and 2D.
counterfactual_rationale: A MI325 ROCm test with Qwen3 strided Q/K RMSNorm views would reproduce it.

rationale: The EADDRINUSE port race is in SHM/ZMQ network binding for distributed serving, not a kernel-correctness root cause.

affected_hardware: Apple Silicon M1 / older Arm CPUs
evidence_snippet: M1 lacks native BF16 support, causing BF16Vec16 and sysconf build errors.
rationale: The fix guards Arm/x86 CPU attention vector and cache-size assumptions.
counterfactual_rationale: An Apple Silicon or older Arm build job would fail at compile time.

rationale: The record is a typo-only change to a blocksparse attention file and has no runtime failure evidence.
The PR makes compressed tensors use DeepGemm when available; the dossier shows optimization/selection, not incorrect behavior or severe failure.

evidence_snippet: A large model hit GPU SEGV in fused_moe_kernel; changing offsets to tl.int64 fixed it.
rationale: Integer overflow in fused MoE offsets caused invalid memory access for very large models.
counterfactual_rationale: Memcheck on a large-model fused-MoE input would flag the invalid load/store.

affected_kernel: RMSNorm and RMSNorm-FP8 quant CUDA kernels
evidence_snippet: FP32 weight path introduced about 0.03 per-element error per layer and only about 2% token match.
rationale: RMSNorm kernels multiplied in FP32 instead of the weight dtype, violating the reference.
counterfactual_rationale: Kernel-vs-Python reference tests over BF16/FP16 weights would catch it.

affected_kernel: CPU extension CMake and CPU attention/quant code
evidence_snippet: The -mf16c flag and FP16 vector types are x86-specific and cause Power build failures.
rationale: The fix adds architecture checks/fallbacks so CPU kernel code builds on Power.
counterfactual_rationale: A Power architecture build job would catch the x86-only flags/types.

evidence_snippet: Uninitialized garbage expert IDs in padding slots made the TRTLLM MoE kernel read uninitialized hidden states and produce NaN.
rationale: The fix marks padding slots invalid so the downstream MoE kernel ignores them.
counterfactual_rationale: Compute-sanitizer initcheck/memcheck would flag use of uninitialized padding slots.

rationale: This is another TCP/port reservation change in disaggregation plumbing, outside kernel correctness.
The PR is ROCm warning, environment-flag, and naming cleanup with no established runtime kernel failure.

introducing_evidence: #43232 moved query FP8 quantization inline behind assert query.is_contiguous
evidence_snippet: Nemotron produces a non-contiguous query view and trips assert query.is_contiguous.
rationale: The assert was stricter than the FP8 quantization kernel stride requirements.
counterfactual_rationale: Attention tests with QKV-split non-contiguous query views would catch it.

rationale: The PR removes a deprecated CUDA device-count helper after an upstream PyTorch fix; no kernel failure is established.

evidence_snippet: Offset was not validated against block_table_stride before accessing batch_block_table, causing OOB access.
rationale: The fix bounds the cache gather loop and partial-block access.
counterfactual_rationale: The new OOB test was verified under compute-sanitizer memcheck.

affected_kernel: RotaryEmbedding RoPE cache for EAGLE long sequences
evidence_snippet: A generated position_id can exceed the RoPE cos_sin_cache length, causing illegal memory access.
rationale: The fix dynamically expands and pre-reserves RoPE cache for long speculative workloads.
counterfactual_rationale: Long speculative sequences with target/draft mismatch are needed to exceed the cache.

affected_kernel: FlashInfer full-attention ragged prefill cache planning
evidence_snippet: Reading unwritten cache slots can mix stale K/V into the result; upstream test max abs error 14.0.
rationale: The fix plans full-attention paged reads over cached prefix lengths only.
counterfactual_rationale: The added regression poisons unwritten slots and compares attention output.

affected_kernel: DeepEP HT All2All + FlashInfer TRTLLM backend selection
evidence_snippet: DeepSeek-R1-NVFP4 crashes with DeepEP high throughput all2all: NotImplementedError.
rationale: The fix rejects an incompatible backend so selection falls through to a supported one.
counterfactual_rationale: Only a WideEP/NVFP4 serving configuration enters this dispatch path.

evidence_snippet: Cache-hit rescore diverged from cold prefill by KL about 1.55; disabling CUDA graph gave KL about 0.002.
rationale: Graph replay handed a stale full static track buffer to track-save metadata, corrupting cache state.
counterfactual_rationale: Requires CUDA graphs, Mamba radix cache, track-save, and cache-hit rescoring.
